about: #528: ↑ · ↓ in the input line bring back lines put in before (Mac PaperCore/InputHistory.swift · Windows core/inputHistory.ts). `steps`: a key pressed with the line's text then; `result` is the line's new text, or null when the key is the field's own (the caret moves). `added`: the history after a line is put in. Words are made up.

steps.case: ↑ on an empty line brings back the newest line, ↑ again the one before
↓ goes back toward the newest, and past it to an empty line
at the oldest line ↑ stays there (the key is still taken)
a line with words typed keeps its ↑ (the caret moves)
a line brought back and then changed stops the walk: ↑ is the field's again
no lines yet: ↑ is the field's own

add.case: a line goes in as the newest, trimmed
the same line again moves to the newest, kept once
